content.name: Lamp
entries: A lamp casts bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Once lit, it burns for 6 hours on a flask (1 pint) of oil.

content.name: Lamp
entries: A Lamp burns {@item Oil|SRD52} as fuel to cast {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 15-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 30 feet.
